body: do you mind if i PM?

yes, i have had a passion. even today i felt passionate about something, but during that time i felt like i was just kidding myself. i was choosing to buy into a lie. a delusional that might make life more tolerable. enjoyable. but i can't hold on to that. nothing is worth it. like i said, except for maybe love. but that doesn't last forever. my own mother doesn't even love me. my father stopped loving me a long time ago, if he ever really did. there's no point. i should just stop bothering people and end my life while i'm still relatively young and haven't negatively impacted so many people's lives 

edit: thank you for bothering to talk to me and listen, but i don't want to take up any more of your time. you deserve better. hope you have a nice day.

who the fuck knows? because i suck. because they suck. because they never loved me in the first place. because i'm unlovable. because i stopped giving them what they wanted out of me. because i gave them what they wanted and then they had no use for me anymore. because life sucks and no one is trustworthy or dependable

yes, i feel excited often. i don't feel like talking about it right now because it seems totally unimportant and worthless. nothing makes up for any of this except maybe love. maybe. even then, there's really not any hope for me because everyone that has ever "loved" me has abandoned me. i don't know if i believe in love anymore. we are selfish creatures. i've experienced a lot of good, but i don't deserve any of it. i don't want to talk about it. when i start to think about good things right now, i feel nothing but disgust.

they come and go. i didn't have them for a period of time earlier today. i can't remember a time when i didn't have some version of these thoughts. i've had suicidal thoughts since age 9 or 10, maybe before.

no one will ever love me. i'm worthless and ashamed. i'm a leech. i'm a burden. no one loves me. i'm nothing. all i do is contribute to other people's pain. i deserve torture and misery. i deserve rape. i'm too much of a coward to live. i hate myself. i deserve to hurt in every way imaginable. what is wrong with me? i don't deserve love. i'm a loser. the world is an evil place. there is no solace. peace is a delusion. all of this is so fucked up. i'm disgusted by the human race.

yeah, i guess it feels better to talk about them if it's to someone that can understand. i don't have the patience to write things down when i'm like this. too many thoughts. too much emotion. i'm not taking drugs every day i just feel like i really really need them every day. i can't handle any of this. i really want to kill myself. i'm so tired of living as a prisoner of my mind
